cases.description: Claims handling standard of a fictional property and motor insurer pasted from a policy document; headings, bullet and numbered lists, a step table and an authority-limits table carry facts that the collapse-then-split import merges into dropped runs.

drafts.label: Written exception
drafts.caption: Written exception is kept. Exceptions register records Written exception.

drafts.label: Claims handler
drafts.caption: Claims handler is kept. Loss registration is executed by Claims handler.

drafts.label: Policy administration system
drafts.caption: Policy administration system is kept. Policy verification uses Policy administration system.

drafts.label: Policy wording
drafts.caption: Policy wording is kept. Coverage check uses Policy wording.

drafts.label: Schedule
drafts.caption: Schedule is kept. Coverage check uses Schedule.

drafts.label: Team leader
drafts.caption: Team leader is kept. Reserve review is approved by Team leader.

drafts.label: Approved engineer
drafts.caption: Approved engineer is kept. Motor assessment is executed by Approved engineer.

drafts.label: Claims surveyor
drafts.caption: Claims surveyor is kept. Property assessment is executed by Claims surveyor.

drafts.label: Loss adjuster
drafts.caption: Loss adjuster is kept. Property assessment is executed by Loss adjuster.

drafts.label: Customer
drafts.caption: Customer is kept. Recorded interview includes Customer.

drafts.label: Claims Manager
drafts.caption: Claims Manager is kept. Claims Manager approves Liability decision.

drafts.label: Senior claims handler
drafts.caption: Senior claims handler is kept. Senior handler authority is owned by Senior claims handler.

drafts.label: Claims team leader
drafts.caption: Claims team leader is kept. Team leader authority is owned by Claims team leader.

notes.explanation: Approved written exceptions must be recorded in the register.
The handler taking the notification completes registration.
Policy verification checks against this system.
The handler reads the policy wording during the coverage check.
The handler also reads the schedule during the coverage check.
The team leader signs off each reserve review.
An approved engineer carries out motor assessment.
A claims surveyor may carry out property assessment.
A loss adjuster may carry out property assessment.
The recorded interview is with the customer.
Fraud-based claim declines are reserved to this role.
The table names the senior-authority holder and limit.
The table names the team-leader-authority holder and limit.
The Head of Claims owns the process.
Delegated authority limits what handlers may offer.
A fraud referral suspends settlement until the investigation concludes.
Triage applies fraud indicators before setting a track.
The repair estimate must be attached before authorisation.
Photo evidence must be attached before authorisation.
Settlement cycle time is reported to the committee monthly.
An offer cannot exceed its maker's delegated authority.
An open fraud referral prevents payment release pending verification.
Subrogation relies on the liability decision.
Total loss evaluation automatically triggers the salvage auction after acceptance and transfer.
The unit reports to the Head of Claims.
The investigation informs the liability decision.
The Head of Claims grants personal authority in writing.
The table names the desk-authority holder and limit.
The table assigns claims-committee authority to the committee.
Breaches of delegated authority are reported to the committee.
Document control identifies the Head of Claims as owner.
